enabled.description: Generate ConfigMaps from the folders in `basePath` when true.

basePath.description: Path in the filesystem of the parent chart that holds the files to convert into ConfigMaps. Files are organised two levels deep: `basePath/configMapName/file`.

configMapsOverrides.description:
Define overrides for the generated ConfigMaps, each key is the name of a folder in basePath.

Each override accepts:

- `forceRename`: Force a specific name for the ConfigMap instead of the auto-generated name
- `annotations`: Additional annotations for the ConfigMap
- `labels`: Additional labels for the ConfigMap
- `fileAttributeOverrides`: Configure how individual files are added to the ConfigMap, per file name
  - `exclude`: If true the file won't be added to the ConfigMap
  - `binary`: If your file is a binary file like an image, set this to true. Takes precedence over escaped
  - `escaped`: If your file contains gotpl syntax that you don't want templated by Helm, set this to true

forceRename.description: Force a specific name for the ConfigMap instead of the auto-generated name

fileAttributeOverrides.description: Configure how individual files are added to the ConfigMap

exclude.description: If true the file won't be added to the ConfigMap

binary.description: If your file is a binary file like an image, set this to true. Takes precedence over escaped

escaped.description: If your file contains gotpl syntax that you don't want templated by Helm, set this to true

description: Generates a ConfigMap for each folder in a directory of the parent chart, with the files of the folder as its entries.
